title: Probability of a complementary event
statement: For any nonnegative integer $m$ and any decidable property $A$ of Boolean strings, the probability that a uniformly random Boolean string of length $m$ does not satisfy $A$ equals one minus the probability that it satisfies $A$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a decidable property of Boolean strings
